title: Several screens say 'Message MettleUp' but give no way to do it
what: When paying MettleUp is not ready or has no payment details, when a gym has more than one branch, when a payment is not confirmed, and when trainer pages are not switched on, the panel tells the owner to message MettleUp (once 'on WhatsApp'). None of these lines has a button, a number or a link, and the panel holds no MettleUp WhatsApp number at all. The owner who wants to pay is left to find a way himself.
expected: Every 'message MettleUp' line carries one tap that reaches MettleUp: Help and feedback, or the support email or WhatsApp number.
how_often: every time one of these states shows
fix_line: Add an Open Help and feedback button (or the support contact) under each 'message MettleUp' line, and drop 'on WhatsApp' unless a number is shown

title: 'Needs you' on Today leaves out people who asked to join online
what: The 'Needs you' count, badge, list and sound cover plan requests, check-in numbers, shop orders, member questions and member messages. A person who asked to join (or paid online and waits for approval) is not one of them, even though the closed-app alerts treat a joining request as urgent. An owner who works from the 'Needs you' list can leave a paid joiner waiting.
expected: A waiting online join request counts in 'Needs you' and takes the owner to it, the same as the alerts do.
fix_line: Add waiting online join requests as one more kind in 'Needs you'

title: The Pay MettleUp code still says its server part is not live, though it is
what: The top note of the Pay MettleUp rules says the server change is not applied, while a note further down and the live database both show it is. Whoever picks up billing next, without the owner to ask, reads two answers.
expected: One true line about whether paying MettleUp is live.
evidence: data:live database function list holds owner_pay_mettleup and owner_report_mettleup_payment (catalog read 2026-11-21)
fix_line: Change the top note to say the payment server part is live

items.reason: Set-up (new gym card), import with undo, trial banner and paying MettleUp read; the support window is described on Help and feedback. No owner-side close-the-gym or take-my-data step lives in this area (only an HQ delete exists in the database), so offboarding is judged elsewhere.
Every 'Open' button path in What's new reaches a real screen; old wording of page names is already a finding.
This area holds no key or token: MettleUp's UPI and bank details and the push key come from the server. Who holds those keys, when they expire and the written way back in are not in this area.
